title: Greek Saganaki with Shrimp
description: A classic Greek dish made with succulent shrimp, crispy saganaki, and a squeeze of fresh lemon.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
3. Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the sliced saganaki to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until crispy.
5. In a small bowl, mix together the feta, parsley, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
6. To assemble the dish, place a cooked shrimp on top of a slice of saganaki, then spoon some of the feta mixture over the top.
